scope: Observation-only adaptive replay of reachable load histories in the known two-block fixture. This step isolates physics/Gaussian inference; no pretrained model or neural head is run.
protocol: Fresh validation/test histories and impact magnitudes. No fitting of search hyperparameters on new response labels.
Each 49-candidate method is charged 49 distinct observation-loss evaluations and 196 Gaussian observation renders, including shared-cache hits. Coarse13 is a smaller-budget reference.
Uniform49 evaluates a fixed grid. Greedy49 refines the single best observed basin. Multiregion49 assigns two proposals to ranked local minima and one to the widest remaining interval each round.
Flat observations use widest-interval exploration and retain ambiguity; no unique point prediction is returned.
All candidates are generated by complete valid load/unload replay, then advanced through the observed known probe. Save full cutoff states before reading future plans.
Future scoring uses only selected physical states in informative test cases. All alternative cutoff states remain available for later branching; they are not averaged into a state.

Identical material, geometry and probe schedules allow a shared forward cache. Report actual cache misses, rendering calls and wall time separately; equal logical budgets do not imply equal measured runtime.
Adaptive one-dimensional search and history replay are not claimed as novel. General 3D fracture remains outside this experiment.
